visual.general_description: Three stacked box-plot panels (A, B, C) of charge in nC per phase for auditory thresholds, auditory comfort levels and facial nerve thresholds, one panel per patient, with a shared legend.
visual.detailed_description: A tall image with three box-plot panels labelled A, B and C and a shared color legend below the last panel. Each panel is titled with a patient number and the number of electrodes its ranges represent (n=8, n=9 and n=7), uses the y-axis "Charge (nC / phase)", and has categorical x-axis conditions (pulse types for A and C, grounding configurations and events for B). Grey boxes mark auditory thresholds, blue boxes auditory comfort levels and red boxes facial nerve thresholds. Panels A and B print speech-score labels (BKB or AB percentages) above some conditions; panel C prints none.

panels.general_description: Box plot of charge for patient 1 across four stimulation conditions, with grey auditory-threshold boxes in all four, blue comfort-level boxes in the first and fourth and red facial-nerve-threshold boxes in the second and third.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A is titled "patient 1 (range represents n=8 electrodes)" with y-axis "Charge (nC / phase)" ticked from 15.00 to 55.00 in steps of 5.00. Four categories are labelled on the x-axis: "Biphasic before severe FNS", "Biphasic after severe FNS", "Triphasic no injection" and "Triphasic with injection". Each category has a grey box with whiskers in the lower part of the plot. The first and fourth categories also have a blue box in the upper part of the plot; the second and third have a red box in the upper part instead. Printed speech scores sit above the categories: "BKB 94%" above the first, "BKB 36%" above the second, "BKB 46%" and "AB 33%" above the third with a "+" mark at the upper right, and "AB 35%" above the fourth. A large letter "A" is printed at the lower left of the panel. The grey boxes lie below the blue or red boxes in every category.
